Economy · India

Banks to remain open on Sunday ahead of proposed three-day strike

India’s Finance Ministry announced that all public sector banks and regional rural banks will operate normally on Sunday, 27 September, giving customers an extra day before the United Forum of Bank Unions’ planned three-day strike from 28 to 30 September. The union is seeking a five-day banking week and other demands. The decision, described as a relief for customers, follows the weekend holidays on 26 and 27 September. The strike is expected to close banks for three days, after which they are slated to reopen on 1 October.
